properties.name: rules
properties.label: Conditional requirements
properties.description: One rule per line: whenField|whenEquals|requiredFields(csv)|message. From 1.1.0 a line may instead be a refusal: !refuse|whenField|whenEquals|field|refusedValues(csv)|message, which refuses the save where the value given for field is one of the refused values (letter case aside), in the message, on that field; an empty value is left to the requirement rule. Emitted from the model's entities[].validations (their require_fields and refuse) — not hand-authored.

properties.name: exists
properties.label: Cross-record preconditions
properties.description: One rule per line: whenField|whenEquals|form|table|theirAttr|ourAttr|where|message. Refuses when the count of matching rows in the other table is ZERO — the mirror of UniqueGuard. Emitted from the model's transitions[].requires — not hand-authored.
